name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A housing scheme providing financial assistance to eligible urban households belonging to the EWS, LIG, and MIG income categories to construct, buy, or improve a pucca house, under the 'Housing for All' mission.
benefits: Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC): financial assistance up to Rs. 2.5 lakh to build a new pucca house on own land. Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP): allotment of ready-built affordable houses. Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS): subsidy on home loans for purchase/construction, for EWS, LIG and MIG categories.
eligibility: Applicant must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Economically Weaker Section (EWS): annual household income up to Rs. 3 lakh
Low Income Group (LIG): annual household income Rs. 3-6 lakh
Middle Income Group (MIG): annual household income Rs. 6-9 lakh
Priority to widows, single women, senior citizens, transgender persons, persons with disabilities, and SC/ST/minority households
Beneficiary must not have availed benefits under any other housing scheme
documents_required: Proof of not owning a pucca house (self-declaration)
how_to_apply: Apply online through the official PMAY-Urban portal (pmay-urban.gov.in) or through your Urban Local Body (ULB) during an active application/survey window. Income category and eligibility are verified before assistance is sanctioned.
